proof: TrainingSessionStore writes JSON/JSONL under file locks with fsync and conflict detection.
Teaching event ids include a session-derived token, preventing same-day cross-session event_id collisions while preserving session-local sequencing.
Replay decisions require Idempotency-Key/X-Idempotency-Key and replay the same stored decision without duplicate commit/discard events.
TrainingSessionStore.mutate_replay serializes replay pending-decision check, bounded persona authority commit, decision event append, and replay write under the replay file lock.

Concurrent HTTP replay commit test proves two same-session requests with the same Idempotency-Key produce one external persona commit call, one commit event, and one persona_commit_terminal_readback evidence record.
RuntimeEvidenceLog.append_or_get performs request_hash match and append under the evidence log exclusive lock; concurrent same-request_hash writers converge to one checksum-linked record.
Missing, malformed, stale, insufficient, digest-mismatched, non-real-vectorbt, or failed-governance proofs raise 409 before completion or commit.

Commit admission re-loads dataset and policy authorities, validates proof TTL/freshness, checks controls and metrics digests, requires completed worker job provenance, and verifies runtime evidence binding.
HTTP tests prove failed governance gate blocks completion and commit path, stale candidate snapshot returns 409, and commit idempotency conflicts return 409 without duplicate event.
Discard writes a terminal runtime-evidence decision ref with after_artifact_ref null and no persona policy mutation.
Negative or unavailable persona/approval authority raises 409/503 before local committed state advances.
No live-capital or live-broker side effect is introduced; compose defaults keep training-session scoped to dev service dependencies and durable volumes.
services/training-session/canonical_dataset.json is deleted from the task diff.

evaluation_authority.load_evaluation_authority requires a DatasetVersion JSON, active threshold policy, trusted service clock, storage checksums, row counts, required instruments, freshness, and vectorbt-ready OHLCV records.
source_dataset_authority.materialize_source_dataset_version resolves source-ingest controller/readback/storage into immutable DatasetVersion materialization before evaluation.
persona_target.py requires authenticated pre-readback, approval readback, target write, and exact terminal target readback with candidate/control/proof/approval digest matching.
Committed artifacts use runtime-evidence decision refs and terminal persona controller refs instead of synthetic trainer-replay refs.
Policy lineage records are built from terminal persona target readback and stored in lineage-read:training-session-policy-lineage.
services/knowledge/evidence/runtime_log.py writes locked O_APPEND JSONL records with recursive redaction, sequence numbers, previous_checksum, per-record checksum, fsync, and full-chain verification.
training-session proofs bind to runtime evidence sequence/checksum; commit admission verifies the referenced terminal preview evidence before mutating replay state.
HTTP tests use temp runtime evidence paths and no longer append to repo deployment evidence during validation.
Runtime evidence request_hash deduplication is now atomic under the log lock and covered by a ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency test.

docker-compose.yml defines training-session-preview-worker without an opt-in profile, restart: unless-stopped, service health dependency, durable training-session volume, and alive-marker healthcheck.

Preview jobs are persisted, leased, fenced by worker_run_id and lease expiry, idempotent by request hash, and bounded by max attempts so a restarted worker resumes claimable work instead of admitting stale success.
TrainingSessionStore uses locked JSON/JSONL persistence with fsync, and RuntimeEvidenceLog appends locked checksum-linked records that verify after process restart.
Discard writes a terminal runtime-evidence decision ref with after_artifact_ref null and no persona policy mutation.
Negative or unavailable persona/approval authority raises 409/503 before local committed state advances.
No live-capital or live-broker side effect is introduced; compose defaults keep training-session scoped to dev service dependencies and durable volumes.

environment_boundary.proof: Training-session changes stay in service/runtime and compose scope; no browser secret path, broker authority, or live-capital route is introduced.

hosted_frontend.proof: No execute-plans frontend artifact is changed by this task.

mfa.proof: No operator/browser write surface is introduced; governed approval remains a downstream authority precondition.

no_live_capital.proof: Rollback/compensation proof records no live broker or live-capital side effect, and compose defaults only start training-session dependencies and durable volumes.

rbac.proof: Persona target write path requires TRAINING_SESSION_PERSONA_AUTHORITY_TOKEN and exact configured authority URLs; missing token or URL fails closed.

tenant_isolation.proof: This task does not add a multi-tenant browser/API surface; source/persona/approval controllers remain downstream authorities.

two_person_approval.proof: Commit admission requires candidate-specific approval authority readback before terminal persona target mutation.

acceptance.statement: no production path references STUB1, STUB2, stub-ref, or manufactures a passing proof
missing, stale, invalid, or insufficient data cannot pass commit admission
default worker records dataset, policy, thresholds, metrics, approval, and terminal persona readback
duplicate job, stale candidate, approval negative, worker restart, and rollback are proven
archive branch, PR, required checks, merge SHA, independent reviewer verdict, and residual risk owner/expiry
use authoritative pre/post readback; submitted, queued, seed, stub, fixture, snapshot, or synthetic receipt is not terminal success
prove duplicate safety, failure/degraded behavior, restart/recovery, and rollback or compensation with admitted-command RPO=0
record exact deployment identity and controller truth when deployed; no registry-only maturity promotion
preserve RBAC, tenant, MFA, two-person, environment, and no-live-capital boundaries wherever applicable
write a redacted append-only checksummed evidence.json; missing, indirect, stale, or contradicted requirements fail closed
